info.name: FinCore API (SIMULATED funds)
info.description:
Simulated digital wallet, double-entry ledger and payments API for an educational assessment. No real money.

Amounts are strings of integer **minor units** (e.g. "125050" = ₹1,250.50). Errors use `{ error: { code, message, details, request_id } }`.

Error catalog: `VALIDATION_ERROR` 400 · `UNAUTHENTICATED` 401 · `REAUTH_REQUIRED` 401 · `FORBIDDEN` 403 · `NOT_FOUND` 404 · `CONFLICT` 409 · `INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION` 409 · `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED` 422 · `INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS` 422 · `LIMIT_EXCEEDED` 422 · `RATE_LIMITED` 429 · `INTERNAL_ERROR` 500 · `UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE` 503
